briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate multi-agent capabilities as US export controls tighten.

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with frontier labs releasing reasoning-focused models. US-China tensions drive compute restrictions while safety concerns mount over agentic systems. DialectForge emerges as a protocol-level solution amid rising vulnerabilities.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with advanced multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Google's Gemini 3.5 Ultra compete on long-context reasoning. Meta open-sourced Llama 4.1 while xAI and DeepSeek push efficiency boundaries with sub-10B parameter specialists.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 1.2M units monthly. Microsoft and Google announce $45B combined data center expansions in Texas and Arizona. TSMC 2nm yields improve for next-gen AI chips.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards like dynamic dialects become mandatory for critical infrastructure by 2028?
